_A_PAGE_MENU_BASIC_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTION: AMenu provides navigation with nested panels, search, groups and disabled links.
_A_PAGE_MENU_NESTED_DESCRIPTION_: Open Components → Form controls to explore nested panels, or search for Input. Scroll the menu inside the container, which has a fixed height of 24rem. Use the button above to toggle the menu, including on mobile. The examples do not change body classes or show a mobile backdrop. Set is-inline to true to place the menu in the normal document flow and fill the height of its container. Give the container an explicit height.
_A_PAGE_MENU_GROUPS_DESCRIPTION_: The group field groups links under headings. The Notification link is disabled, and has-search is false. Scroll the menu inside the 24rem container and use the button above to open or close it.
_A_PAGE_MENU_DOM_DESCRIPTION_: The search-in-dom prop defaults to false. When true, search reads the rendered labels in the source menu panels instead of labels in data. Turn on the translation switch, then search for Eingabe or Auswahl: the data still contains Input and Select. Results, highlighting and parent labels use the DOM text. Text is reread when the search query changes, including in closed submenus. Custom slots should preserve the supplied link id and wrap the label in .a_menu__link__text. Turn the switch off to restore the original English labels.
_A_PAGE_MENU_CUSTOM_KEYS_DESCRIPTION_: Map existing data fields with key-id, key-label, key-icon, key-group and key-children. This example uses code, title, symbol, section and items without renaming the source fields. Routes still use to. Open Form controls or search for Input.
_A_PAGE_MENU_BREADCRUMBS_DESCRIPTION_: Open Components → Form controls → Text fields. With is-breadcrumbs-truncated, parent links that do not fit move into the breadcrumb dropdown. The switch controls show-count-children so you can show or hide submenu item counts.
